content.value_statement: Teams need reliable ways to create and convert diagrams without rebuilding assets by hand. This skill guides LibreOffice Draw workflows for ODG creation, vector editing, and local format export.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of ODG drawings with LibreOffice Draw and UNO examples.
Shows local conversion paths from ODG to SVG, PDF, PNG, JPG, and related formats.
Describes batch conversion workflows using the soffice command-line interface.
Explains shape, layer, label, path, and Bezier curve editing concepts.
Lists troubleshooting steps for LibreOffice headless socket and PNG export quality issues.
limitations: Requires LibreOffice or compatible UNO tooling in the user environment.
Does not automatically validate conversion fidelity for a specific document.
Command examples can modify local files and should be approved before execution.
Does not provide custom drawing assets or domain-specific visual standards.

use_cases.title: Publish Documentation Diagrams
use_cases.description: Plan ODG source diagrams and export SVG or PDF assets for manuals, release notes, and internal guides.

use_cases.title: Automate Diagram Exports
use_cases.description: Build repeatable local conversion workflows for drawing files that must ship in multiple formats.

use_cases.title: Create Process Flowcharts
use_cases.description: Turn process steps into structured LibreOffice Draw diagrams with labels, connectors, layers, and export guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Convert One Drawing
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the draw skill to convert my ODG file to PDF. Confirm the source file path, output folder, and command approval before running anything.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Flowchart
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a simple diagram from process steps
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the draw skill to plan an ODG flowchart for this process: [steps]. Include shapes, labels, layers, and export recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Export Diagrams
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the draw skill to design a batch conversion workflow for these ODG files: [list]. Include safety checks, destination naming, and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Automate UNO Generation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the draw skill to outline a Python UNO approach for generating a technical diagram from this data: [data]. Include document structure, shapes, connector rules, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: Convert architecture.odg to SVG and PDF.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms paths and approval, then provides LibreOffice Draw conversion steps and verification checks.

output_examples.input: Create an org chart from a team list.
output_examples.output: A diagram plan with role boxes, reporting connectors, layer guidance, and export options.
A troubleshooting response that increases export dimensions, checks source vector quality, and asks for a sample if quality remains poor.

best_practices: Keep ODG source files under version control when diagrams support documentation or releases.
Confirm file paths, output formats, and command approval before any local conversion.
Use layers, object names, and templates for diagrams that will be maintained over time.
anti_patterns: Running batch conversion commands before reviewing the target folder and overwrite behavior.
Using raster exports as the only source for diagrams that need later editing.
Assuming every SVG or PDF imports cleanly without manual inspection.

faq.question: Does this skill create drawings directly?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and automation patterns. Actual drawing creation depends on LibreOffice, UNO, and available local files.

faq.question: Which formats are covered?
faq.answer: The skill covers ODG, SVG, PDF, PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP, WMF, and EMF workflows described in the source file.

faq.question: Can it run LibreOffice commands?
faq.answer: It can suggest local commands. The user or agent should confirm paths and permission before running them.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: No core workflow requires internet access. The skill includes reference links and optional package installation examples.

faq.question: Is it only for programmers?
faq.answer: No. Writers and analysts can use the planning guidance, while developers can use the command-line and UNO examples.

faq.question: Can it guarantee export quality?
faq.answer: No. Export quality depends on the source drawing, filters, fonts, and local LibreOffice version.
